title: Agilent HPLC & Server Deployment Project
description: Successfully led the installation, configuration, and network integration of Agilent HPLC laboratory systems and the Agilent CSV infrastructure within a GMP-compliant pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.
longDescription:
Successfully led the installation, configuration, and network integration of Agilent High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) laboratory systems and the Agilent CSV (Centralized Server Validation) infrastructure within a GMP-compliant pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

The project involved server deployment, network architecture planning, IP configuration, connectivity validation, user access provisioning, system integration, and infrastructure support to ensure reliable communication between laboratory instruments and centralized data management systems. Collaborated closely with Quality Control, Validation, and Engineering teams to ensure system readiness for regulated pharmaceutical operations.

The implementation improved laboratory system reliability, centralized data management capabilities, and operational efficiency while supporting compliance with GMP, EU-GMP, NMRA, and other regulatory requirements.
achievements: Led end-to-end deployment and network integration of Agilent HPLC systems.
Configured and integrated Agilent CSV server infrastructure.
Established secure communication between laboratory instruments and server platforms.
Supported validation and compliance activities within a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
Enhanced laboratory system availability and operational reliability.
Contributed to successful regulatory audits with zero major IT-related observations.

title: Enterprise Backup & Disaster Recovery Automation
description: Designed and implemented a dual-domain enterprise backup and disaster recovery architecture using Veeam Backup & Replication to protect critical pharmaceutical manufacturing, laboratory, and corporate infrastructure.
longDescription:
Designed and implemented a dual-domain enterprise backup and disaster recovery architecture using Veeam Backup & Replication to protect critical pharmaceutical manufacturing, laboratory, and corporate infrastructure.

The project covered two independent environments consisting of an isolated Quality Control (QC) laboratory domain and the primary corporate domain. The solution protected over 70 critical systems including Domain Controllers, Building Management Systems (BMS), SCADA platforms, HPLC workstations, FTIR systems, Total Organic Carbon (TOC) analyzers, Polarimeters, Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometers (AAS), Stability Control Systems, Laboratory Information Systems, and VMware virtual infrastructure.

Implemented automated backup scheduling, repository management, recovery validation, monitoring, retention policies, and disaster recovery procedures using Veeam Backup & Replication Enterprise Plus. Configured and maintained both local repository infrastructure and large-scale SMB-based backup storage environments exceeding 250 TB of protected capacity.

Integrated VMware ESXi infrastructure protection, agent-based backups for laboratory systems, centralized monitoring through Veeam ONE, and proactive backup verification processes to ensure business continuity and regulatory compliance within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.
achievements: Designed a dual-domain Veeam backup infrastructure for QC and corporate networks.
Protected 70+ critical systems across pharmaceutical manufacturing and laboratory operations.
Managed 250+ TB of backup storage and 13+ automated backup jobs.
Secured HPLC, SCADA, BMS, FTIR, TOC, and Domain Controller environments.
Supported GMP, EU-GMP, NMRA, and ISO compliance requirements.

title: Experimental Rocket Research & Development Project
description: Independently researched, designed, and developed an experimental rocket project focusing on aerospace engineering principles, propulsion concepts, aerodynamics, flight stability, and safety management.
longDescription:
Independently researched, designed, and developed an experimental rocket project during secondary education, focusing on aerospace engineering principles, propulsion concepts, aerodynamics, flight stability, launch mechanisms, and safety management.

The project was conducted with support and guidance from relevant Sri Lankan aviation and defense-sector stakeholders, including the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka and the Sri Lanka Air Force, to ensure adherence to safety and operational requirements associated with experimental rocket activities.

Managed the complete project lifecycle independently, including technical research, design, planning, testing, documentation, risk assessment, and experimental validation. Obtained the required regulatory authorizations and permits applicable to the project at the time, demonstrating an understanding of safety, compliance, and responsible project execution.

The project provided practical exposure to engineering methodologies, scientific experimentation, risk management, and technical problem-solving, helping establish a strong foundation for future work in technology and engineering.
achievements: Independently conceived, researched, and executed an experimental rocket project.
Conducted studies on propulsion systems, aerodynamics, and flight stability.
Managed project planning, testing, documentation, and technical validation activities.
Worked within applicable safety and regulatory frameworks for experimental rocket operations.
Coordinated with relevant aviation and defense-sector stakeholders during project activities.
Developed practical experience in engineering research, experimentation, and risk management.
